items.title: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash Released
items.summary: DeepSeek has launched version 4.1, introducing significant enhancements to its AI capabilities. Developers should explore these updates for improved performance in their AI applications.

items.title: Llmspeed: Benchmark Local LLM Performance
items.summary: Llmspeed provides a platform for users to test the performance of local LLMs before purchasing hardware. This tool is essential for developers looking to optimize their AI infrastructure.

items.title: Llama.cpp Enables GGUF Models on PS5
items.summary: The Llama.cpp project allows developers to run GGUF models natively on jailbroken PS5 consoles. This opens new avenues for gaming and AI integration on console platforms.

items.title: Apple MLX: Muse Spark Open for Distributed Inference
items.summary: Apple has introduced Muse Spark Open with MLX, enabling distributed inference on Mac Studio. This advancement is crucial for developers working on scalable machine learning applications.

items.title: JPEG XL vs. AVIF: A Comparative Analysis
items.summary: A new analysis compares JPEG XL and AVIF for web use-cases, highlighting their strengths and weaknesses. Developers should consider these findings when choosing image formats for web projects.
